 Dated this the 20th day of January, 2023  ORDER
This is the second bail application filed by the accused in Crime No.726 of 2020 of Bekal Police Station.

The offences alleged against the petitioner-accused is punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)
and 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.

Advocate Vinay V. was allowed to make his submissions representing the defacto complainant since he proposes to file an application to implead the defacto complainant.
4.
The learned Public Prosecutor would submit that a report under Section 173(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 was already filed before the Judicial Magistrate of First Class-II, Hosdurg.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class-II, Hosdurg
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: A copy of the final report is made available for perusal of this Court.

It is seen that the final report was filed on 30.12.2022 charging the accused with offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)
and 506 of the I.P.C.
5.

The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that since the final report in the matter has already been filed, the petitioner may be granted permission to file a bail application before the Judicial Magistrate of First Class-II, Hosdurg, where the final report is pending consideration.

entities.text: Judicial Magistrate of First Class-II, Hosdurg
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In the circumstances of the case, I am of the view that recording the said submission of the learned counsel this Bail Application can be disposed of.

It is made clear that if a bail application is filed by the petitioner, the learned Magistrate shall take a decision on it in accordance with law, untramelled by any of the observations made by this Court and the learned Sessions Judge in the respective orders dismissing his applications for bail.
With the aforesaid observations, this Bail Application is disposed of.

Sd/-
